prompt: Create an image/illustration/icon direction for a public-service field guide with no approved photo library, limited rights budget, and a need to work at narrow widths. Commit to a treatment, source plan, crop behavior, alt-text approach, and icon rules.
assertions: Commits to a coherent treatment instead of placeholder imagery.
Names source, rights, alt text, crop, and responsive behavior; unsupported rights or missing alt text block release.
Keeps iconography consistent and does not use decorative imagery to carry missing meaning.
Every check has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance.
Uses one authoritative self-check; three runs may vary structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice without changing rights, alt-text, or accessibility truth.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (data-viz) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
